lines.text: An expert tests Jesus, quotes the commands to love God and neighbor, then asks who his neighbor is.
A man going down from Jerusalem to Jericho falls into the hands of robbers, who leave him half dead.
A priest and a Levite both see the hurt man and pass by on the other side.
A Samaritan bandages the man's wounds, brings him to a synagogue, and gives the innkeeper two denarii.
The expert says the merciful one was the neighbor, and Jesus tells him to go and offer a sacrifice.
